title: Protokollbindungen
subtitle: Verwaltete A2A- und MCP-Bindungen erstellen, prüfen und abgleichen, ohne unbekannte Evidenz als Erfolg auszugeben.

workspace.requiredBody: Protocol bindings require an explicit workspace scope. Choose one in the workspace switcher.

specs.title: Binding specifications
specs.description: Immutable desired generations and their server-observed activation witness.
specs.emptyBody: No specification matches this workspace and filter.

bindings.title: Binding instances
bindings.description: Runtime instances pinned to one exact specification generation.
bindings.emptyBody: No runtime instance matches this workspace and filter.

outcome.unknownBody: Die Control Plane konnte die Beobachtung nicht abschließen. Lesen Sie die Evidenz erneut.
outcome.brokenTitle: The requested condition was not met
outcome.brokenBody: Review the reported code and plan before continuing.
outcome.replayed: The control plane replayed the already committed result; it did not apply a second change.

composer.title: Compose protocol binding draft
composer.description: Define one pinned, declarative A2A or MCP generation. Validation and planning do not write state.
composer.pinnedVersionHelp: Use an exact protocol version; latest, current, and * are rejected.
composer.peerHelp: Use the onboarded peer authority. Do not paste credentials or secret-bearing URLs.
composer.resourceHelp: The local selector is stored as an exact id selector. The remote reference remains opaque and contains no credential.
composer.ruleRefsHelp: One durable rule reference per line.

generationMode.label: Generation workflow
generationMode.help: Create generation 1 or derive an immutable successor from one active specification.
generationMode.predecessorHelp: The successor copies the exact desired configuration, increments generation, and never copies validation evidence.
generationMode.partialCatalog: Only the loaded active-specification page is shown; refresh the list if the predecessor is absent.

endpointCatalog.label: Known active-spec peer
endpointCatalog.help: Choices come from active specifications visible to you. They are references, not a live endpoint heartbeat.
endpointCatalog.select: Reuse a known peer and remote resource

resourceCatalog.label: Authorized local resource catalog
resourceCatalog.help: The picker uses the existing permission-filtered product API.
resourceCatalog.unavailable: No list API or effective read permission is available for this resource kind.
resourceCatalog.truncated: The server reported more resources than this page contains; an exact ID remains available below.
resourceCatalog.exactFallback: Exact IDs are still checked by server validation and do not grant access.

mapping.title: Typed mappings
mapping.help: Only the allowlisted declarative transforms below can be sent; executable code is not accepted.

losses.title: Known semantic losses
losses.help: Every accepted loss needs an explicit durable acceptance reference before activation.
losses.none: No known semantic loss is declared.

coverage.title: Mapping versus accepted-loss matrix
coverage.help: Every row comes from the executable mapping catalog. Required rows must be mapped or backed by an accepted loss reference.

permissions.title: Effective permission preview
permissions.help: These memberships come from the engine-issued whoami permission set. Exact resource policy and capability are still decided by server validation.
permissions.knownProfilesHelp: Profiles are reused only from visible active specifications; the exact reference remains editable.

review.unverifiedTitle: This browser cannot issue the activation witness
review.unverifiedBody: Der Browser lässt den schreibgeschützten Nachweis aus. Validierung und Plan zeigen das serverseitig abgeleitete Ergebnis; die Aktivierung erfordert weiterhin einen serverseitig gespeicherten, zeitgestempelten CLEAN-Nachweis.
review.exportJSON: Export desired spec and server evidence as JSON

diff.title: Plan → apply comparison
diff.plannedHelp: The server plan pins this exact operation, lineage, and hash set before any write.
diff.appliedHelp: The returned write is compared field-for-field with the pinned plan.

flow.planning: Computing the canonical plan and hashes…
flow.failed: The request failed. No draft state is claimed.
flow.createdVerified: Der Server lieferte einen zeitgestempelten CLEAN-Nachweis. Die Ressource bleibt bis zu einer separaten erfolgreichen Aktivierung ein Entwurf.
flow.createdUnverified: The returned resource is a draft and remains unverified; it is not active.

detail.specDescription: Desired generation, hashes, losses, and activation evidence.
detail.bindingDescription: Pinned runtime identity, state, and observation evidence.

blocker.state: Only a draft can be activated.
blocker.witness: Activation requires a timestamped CLEAN witness issued by the server.
blocker.losses: Every known loss must be accepted with a durable reference.
blocker.disable: Only a draft or active specification can be disabled.

activate.title: Activate specification
activate.description: Re-read, validate, and plan the exact draft before activating it.

disable.title: Disable specification
disable.description: Re-read, validate, and plan the exact specification before disabling it.

phase.refreshing: Reading the latest specification and ETag…

transition.broken: The transition preconditions were not met.
transition.failed: The transition failed. The previous state remains the only state shown.
transition.conflict: The specification changed after it was read. Re-read and review a new plan.

reconcile.title: Reconcile binding instance
reconcile.description: Validate and plan locally, test the peer without writing, then record the exact observed result.

phase.refreshing: Reading the latest instance and ETag…
phase.testing: Reading remote state without changing local state…

reconcile.unknown: The remote observation could not be completed. Nothing is recorded as clean or broken.
reconcile.broken: Local validation or planning found a broken precondition.
reconcile.failed: Reconciliation failed. No new observation is claimed.
reconcile.conflict: The instance changed after it was read. Re-read and review a new plan.
